rationale: Reallocate the fixed fp16 export budget inside the winning reverse-tail recurrent family: keep recurrent tail K/V in fp16 across the repeated tail blocks, and spend the freed slot on the final tail Q matrix instead of carrying full recurrent Q rescue everywhere. This stays byte-neutral, targets the exact int8+zlib roundtrip path directly, and is a cleaner structural pivot than another scalar sweep after the recent flat/bad curriculum runs.
title: Tail Value-Path FP16 Reallocation
